Title: varchar blob_to_string (
Description:
Although primarily used for converting blobs ( long varbinary , long varchar ) to string , blob_to_string may also be used to convert from wide string , persistent 
	XML (XPER) and string_output streams . If the data being 
	converted is longer than maximum length of a string , blob_to_string will signal an error.
blob_to_string
blob_to_string
This function is equivalent to
cast (x as varchar)
.
      Using cast is preferred.
cast
